name: Essence of Obsession
subtitle: filled with bombs and/or keys
rules: Choose one of the following as this card's rules text: -- OPTION 1 -- An opponent discards a card. -- OPTION 2 -- EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains COVERT. -- OPTION 3 -- EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character loses 2 strength.

name: Horrendous Behemoth
subtitle: just relax and go with it, man
rules: While this card is in a battle, characters in the opposing party lose 1 strength and 1 speed.
flavor: In his belly you will find a new definition of pain and suffering as you are slowly digested over a thousand years.

name: Day of the Tentacle
subtitle: we may not live to see yesterday
rules: Look at an opponent's hand and choose a non-resource card in it. Put it into play under that opponent's control as a face-down resource.
flavor: What possible harm could one insane, mutant tentacle do?

name: Obscene Astrologer
subtitle: you can see anything in the stars
rules: GAZE UPON THE "STARS" -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – You may deploy a tactic with numeric cost X or less for free, where X is either 5 or the number of [O] you control, whichever is lower.

name: Defiler of Innocence
subtitle: ugh, wizards
rules: CORRUPT -- COST – Pay 2. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains COVERT. -- DEFILE -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Look at an opponent's hand and choose a character in it. That player discards that character.
